description:
🏡📞 I recently got a call from a heartbroken buyer who found me online… and their story is one I never want you to experience. 😢

They had been looking at homes with another agent, but unfortunately, they hadn’t gone over the first step that would have made all the difference.

🔑 They finally found the one. The home they could picture their future in. They were ready to put in an offer… and then they spoke with a lender for the first time. 😨

💰 That’s when reality hit:
❌ HOA fees? Way higher than expected.
❌ Interest rates? Not what they assumed.
❌ Insurance costs? A total shock.

Their dream home was suddenly out of reach. 💔 They felt blindsided, misled, and completely back to square one. 😞

I never want that to happen to you. 🙅‍♀️ That’s why when buyers come to me, the very first thing I do is connect them with a lender. 💼

✔️ I help you figure out your real budget before you fall in love with a home.
✔️ I set clear expectations about monthly payments that actually work for you.
✔️ I make sure you‘re shopping smart—so there are no surprises.

🏡 Buying a home should be exciting, not stressful! 🎉 If 2025 is your year to become a homeowner, let’s start the right way—with a plan. ✨ Send me a DM and let’s get started! 📩💬
